use_case: Calibration drift prediction (predictive maintenance for client radiation survey instruments): flags instruments likely to be out of tolerance at their next calibration so the lab can suggest early recalls and plan loaners
vendor_or_model: Calibration system vendor's machine-learning analytics module in SYS-02 (vendor SaaS; trained on pooled customer data)
data_categories: Instrument make, model, and serial number; calibration and repair history; client name and site; free-text location notes (some name rooms holding category 2 devices); technician initials
affects_individuals: No (indirect: clients' workers rely on the instruments)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; Safety/CI if ever used to lengthen calibration intervals or pass instruments
human_in_the_loop: Calibration Laboratory Technician reviews the weekly list and decides every early recall; the model can never lengthen an interval, skip a calibration, or decide pass or fail; every instrument is still calibrated against the reference
applicable_laws: Client license calibration duties (10 CFR 20.1501(c); 10 CFR 35.61 for medical licensees; Agreement State equivalents); Part 37 client contracts (37.43(d) flow-down) for location notes; FTC Act Section 5 for accuracy claims

use_case: Generative AI assistant built into the productivity suite (summarize, draft, and search across mail and files)
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor's generative AI add-on
data_categories: Everything the signed-in user can reach in the suite, today including all 6 clients' Part 37 folders
risk_tier: High if enabled before restricted folders exist
applicable_laws: Part 37 client contracts (37.43(d)(1) flow-down): the assistant could surface client security information to unapproved staff
status: Proposed; must stay off until restricted folders are in place and a P10 assessment approves it (POL-04 4.6)

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft or reformat text
data_categories: Risk of client security information or personal information being pasted (happened once, June 2026)
risk_tier: High if client information is entered
applicable_laws: Part 37 client contracts (37.43(d)(1) flow-down); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) for personal information
status: Prohibited for any Client Security-Related, Restricted, or Confidential information (POL-04 4.6; POL-02 C.2)
